morbi.headline: Mixed week for Morbi: Tile export projections drop while propane availability lowers input costs
what_changed: Somany Ceramics projected total tile exports to decline to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Morbi ceramic units reduced PNG consumption following an improved supply of propane.
Apollo Pipes set a revenue target of Rs 1,000 crore for its ceramics business.
stress_signals: Overall tile exports projected to fall to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore [202e1481c238]
improvement_signals: Reduction in PNG consumption across ceramic units due to better propane supply availability [81469af468f3]
what_to_watch: Propane vs. PNG cost differentials and actual fuel substitution volumes in Morbi cluster.
Export order book trends and destination-specific demand slowdowns for tile exporters.
Apollo Pipes' market entry strategy and potential manufacturing partnerships or capacity setups.

surat.headline: Diamond demand rebounds ahead of Christmas while textiles face post-Diwali retail inflation slowdown
what_changed: Surat textile trading reopened after Diwali on Labh Panchami amid reports of inflation curbing retail buying.
Crude oil prices fell 17% in 10 days, providing anticipated cost relief for MMF textiles.
Surat diamond units halved Diwali breaks as pre-Christmas export orders pushed gems and jewellery exports up 34.01%.
stress_signals: Rising inflation has reportedly reduced consumer retail buying, causing distress among local textile traders [0fed4a76da43]
A massive fire struck a textile waste godown requiring nine fire tenders to control the blaze [317f5c9fd10d]
improvement_signals: Gem and jewellery exports jumped 34.01% driven by pre-Christmas demand for polished diamonds and studded gold jewellery [c3b68570a07d]
Surat diamond units halved their Diwali break to fulfill improved order books [5fc0b7b85616]
A 17% decline in crude oil prices over 10 days is easing raw material cost pressures for the MMF textile cluster [71350aa24679]
what_to_watch: Textile trading order book velocity and trade credit extensions post-Labh Panchami reopening.
Conversion of the 17% crude oil price decline into lower yarn procurement costs and margin relief for weavers.
Sustained cash flow improvements and export bill realisations among polished diamond processors through the Christmas cycle.
